notes.title: 1.1.0 Patch Note
notes.content:
Hello, this is BullyStore development team !!

We have completed the "Bully Store" update.

[h1][u][b]
The following is the update content.[/b][/u][/h1]
[list]
[*]  Difficulty Balance
Customers wait time
[Easy 120 seconds, Normal 90 seconds, Hard 60 seconds]
[*]  Balance additional score according to difficulty.
[*]  Balance bad customer spawn time according to difficulty.
[*]  Fixed hotdog rotation
[*]  While playing game, if you turn back you can reference the recipe.
[*]  Vibration of controller in interaction
[*]  After finishing the game, it's easier to check your score more easily.
[*]  Change the difficulty level to increase sequentially.
[*]  Order UI of character
[/list]

[Setting]
Apply scrollbar when let go after moving with trigger.
[list]
[*] BGM : Can control BGM sound.
[*] Height Setting : Can set height to play comfortably.
[*] Use Current Location : Set position according to current location. ( Don't have to use if room settings are well done.)
[*] Reset : Reset height setting, and current location.
[/list]

I'm going to reflect your discussion and show you that it's getting better and better.

Thank you for reading.
